header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: Same was the position on last date of hearing viz 31-10-2024. Thereafter, no effort was made by the petitioners to proceed with the instant Petition and is pending without any progress; which reflects that petitioners and their counsel have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same alongwith pending listed application stands dismissed for nonprosecution.
